title: C-Day
description: Cheating Mod, adding 2 New items , and new Crafting Recipes!
body:
A very simple cheating mod with crafting recipes that allow the player to beat the game fast

Adds:
- Ender Tea, an item which when eaten gives a eye of ender
- New Crafting Recipes (for Example: Ender-Tea with a bottle and ender pearl , two oak-logs for 15 endstone , and 1 endstone and eye of ender for end portal frame)
- Temu-Sword, a Sword from the chinese Temu, makes 10,000 attack damage.


*Note: This Mod is only a joke and will not be Updated to Newer Versions so idc about the profile image
